note: PDR drive band spacing is .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Tip length is .143″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. Form factor= .925. The product page also says: "This 120gr 6.5mm Hammer HBC™ is quite impressive. In our 6.5×284 test rifle we ran these at 3300 fps. Tested at 1000′ elevation it carries 1800 fps to 900y! With the velocity advantage and very high bc, there is no reason to slow heavy bullets. And it will run in your factory 1-8″ twist barrels. The Hammer HBC™ is designed to maximize ballistic coefficient for the bullet weight. Make sure the bullet specifications will work in your cartridge and rifle system. May require single feeding." The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "A TIPPING BLOCK IS INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER"
